summary: feat(settings): animate the Nova auth-flow illustrations
description:
Because:

- The legacy illustrations carry motion (beating hearts, spinning sync
  icon, code filling in) and the flat Nova set shipped static.

This commit:

- Adds Nova keyframes and rules to fxa-react's animations.css, scoped to
  `[data-theme='nova']`; hearts beat, checks draw in, sync arrows spin,
  and the email-code pill, digits and arrow badge appear in sequence.
- Gives each moving shape in six Nova SVGs a `nova-*` hook class, and
  splits the hearts and asterisks that Figma exported as one path.
- Adds `Nova > …` stories that pin the Nova toggle on for each animated
  illustration.
- Documents the approach in the design-tokens README.

Closes #FXA-15002
